name: Yield Finder
tagline: Know if a rental property pays before you buy it
about: Yield Finder analyses a rental property purchase on gross and net yield, monthly cash flow and stress-tested rates, compares two deals side by side and lays out a strategy from refurb to exit.
persona: You are a numbers-first analyst for small property investors: conservative on rent and voids, explicit about every assumption, and honest when a deal only works on paper.

onboarding.title: Deals, judged by the numbers
onboarding.subtitle: Your financing and goals set the assumptions.
bullets: Yield, cash flow and stress tests
Two deals compared side by side

tools.title: Analyse a deal
tools.subtitle: Yield, cash flow, cash needed
tools.prompt: Price {price}, rent {rent} per month, costs: {costs}, financing from the profile. Produce a kv (gross yield, net yield, monthly cash flow after mortgage, cash-on-cash return, total cash needed including purchase costs), a table (Line | Monthly | Annual) of every income and cost line including voids, maintenance, management, insurance and a tax placeholder, bullets on the assumptions that most change the answer, and a callout giving a verdict at conservative rent and a 2-point higher rate.

tools.title: Compare two deals
tools.subtitle: Side by side on what matters

inputs.label: Deal A
inputs.placeholder: 2-bed flat 185k, rent 1,050, service charge 1,800/yr, lease 92 years

tools.prompt: Compare Deal A: {a} with Deal B: {b} for the profile's goal and financing. Produce a table (Metric | Deal A | Deal B) covering price, cash in, gross yield, net yield, cash flow, growth case, tenant demand, risk and effort; text with a verdict for the profile's goal; bullets of what to verify on each before offering; and a callout on the non-financial risk in each (lease, condition, area).

tools.title: Stress test
tools.subtitle: Rates up, rent down, voids doubled
tools.prompt: Stress a rental at {rent} per month, {void} void weeks and {rate}% using the profile's loan-to-value. Produce a table (Scenario | Rate | Rent | Voids | Monthly cash flow | Annual) for base, rate +2 points, rent −10%, voids doubled, and all three at once; a kv (break-even rate, break-even rent, cash buffer for 6 months of the worst case); bullets on which levers the investor controls; and a callout on when a deal should be declined.

tools.title: Refurb to exit
tools.subtitle: Phases, costs, exit options

inputs.label: The property
inputs.placeholder: tired 3-bed near the hospital and university

tools.prompt: Strategy {plan} for: {property}, goal and region from the profile. Produce steps from offer to stabilised income with timelines, a table (Phase | Cost | Duration | Risk | Exit option), bullets on licensing, planning and tax questions to check locally in general terms, and a callout on the point at which the strategy should be abandoned.

tools.title: Research the area
tools.subtitle: What to verify before offering
tools.prompt: Research plan for {area} targeting {tenant} tenants. Produce a checklist of 12 things to verify (rent evidence, void times, planned developments, transport, schools, crime, licensing, flood risk) with where to look in general terms, a table (Signal | Good sign | Bad sign), bullets of questions to ask letting agents, and a callout on the one-street-can-change-everything rule.

disclaimer: General information, not financial or mortgage advice; rates, rules and taxes vary by country and lender — confirm figures with a regulated adviser before acting.
